In the center, a tiny brown-and-white dwarf hamster wearing a small navy blue captain's cap sits inside the wicker gondola of a miniature hot air balloon. In the background, there is a white nursery bookshelf filled with colorful books and plush toys, bright orange and green plastic storage bins on a patterned green carpet, and an arched window to the left.
